content.intro: This lesson introduces serialization with pickle and its security limitations as part of file handling and data serialization. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: File and data handling should make encoding, paths, data format, permissions, and failure cases explicit. Never deserialize untrusted pickle data.
